title: Craft Green Dye
description: The ability to combine blue and yellow dye in the crafting table to make green dye.
body: Adds the ability to craft green dye using yellow and blue dye. Simply combine the two dyes in a crafting menu in any location, and the green dye will craft. For versions below 26.2, it may say that the pack is incompatible. You should run it anyway, as it will still work.
